title: Representation of a finite-mass integer multiplicity current by integer-weighted Lipschitz pieces (supplied steps 1–3: normalization, B1, B2, B2′)
statement: Assume, as hypotheses, (CB) the frozen type of Submission.cmcdt_lp_covector_norm_bounds ((L1) |A^#β| ≤ ‖A‖^k|β|, (L2) |ι_vβ| ≤ |v||β|, (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ), and (VO), (MR), (IMC) the frozen types of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support, Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure and Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub (exact Lean texts, as antecedents). Let N, k ∈ ℕ, n := k + 1, and let X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be integer multiplicity with M(X) < ∞. Then there are, for i ∈ ℕ, maps G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N, sets A_i ⊆ ℝⁿ and functions w_i : ℝⁿ → ℤ and c_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ with the following properties. Each G_i is Lipschitz, each A_i is Borel, and each w_i and each c_i is measurable. G_i is differentiable at every u ∈ A_i, and G_i(A_i) ⊆ spt X. w_i is Lebesgue integrable on A_i. For u ∈ A_i, c_i(u) ≥ 0 and |α(DG_i(u)e_0, …, DG_i(u)e_{n−1})| ≤ c_i(u)·|α| for every n-covector α on ℝ^N, where e_a is the standard basis of ℝⁿ and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α. Σ_i ∫_{A_i} |w_i|·c_i dλ ≤ M(X) in [0, ∞]. And for every test form η ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^N), Σ_i ∫_{A_i} w_i(u)·η(G_i(u))(DG_i(u)e_0, …, DG_i(u)e_{n−1}) du = X(η), as a HasSum.
